# pve_metrics_server (Data Source)

Reads an external metric server configuration from `GET /cluster/metrics/server/{id}`. Attributes that do not apply to the server's plugin `type` are null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_metrics_server" "influx" {
  id = "influx1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The metric server identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `api_path_prefix` (String) API path prefix inserted between `<host>:<port>/` and `/api2/` when the InfluxDB service runs behind a reverse proxy.
- `bucket` (String) The InfluxDB bucket/db (http v2 API only).
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is disabled.
- `influxdb_proto` (String) InfluxDB transport protocol. One of `udp`, `http`, `https`; only set for `type` = `influxdb`.
- `max_body_size` (Number) InfluxDB max-body-size in bytes; requests are batched up to this size.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU for metrics transmission over UDP; only set for `graphite` or `influxdb` servers.
- `organization` (String) The InfluxDB organization (http v2 API only).
- `otel_compression` (String) Compression algorithm for requests. One of `none`, `gzip`; only set for `type` = `opentelemetry`.
- `otel_headers` (String) Custom HTTP headers in JSON format, base64 encoded.
- `otel_max_body_size` (Number) Maximum request body size in bytes.
- `otel_path` (String) OTLP endpoint path.
- `otel_protocol` (String) HTTP protocol. One of `http`, `https`; only set for `type` = `opentelemetry`.
- `otel_resource_attributes` (String) Additional resource attributes as JSON, base64 encoded.
- `otel_timeout` (Number) HTTP request timeout in seconds.
- `otel_verify_ssl` (Boolean) Whether SSL certificates are verified.
- `path` (String) Root graphite path; only set for `type` = `graphite`.
- `port` (Number) Server network port.
- `proto` (String) Protocol used to send graphite data. One of `udp`, `tcp`; only set for `type` = `graphite`.
- `server` (String) Server DNS name or IP address.
- `timeout` (Number) Graphite TCP socket timeout in seconds; only set for `type` = `graphite`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The InfluxDB access token; if the v2 compatibility API is used, this carries `user:password`.
- `type` (String) Plugin type of the metric server. One of `graphite`, `influxdb`, `opentelemetry`.
- `verify_certificate` (Boolean) Whether certificate verification is enabled for https endpoints.
